headlines.title: Smoke Blankets Oregon
headlines.summary: Lightning storms have ignited dozens of fires in central and eastern Oregon.

headlines.title: NASA Astronaut Chris Williams to Discuss Space Station Mission
headlines.summary: NASA astronaut Chris Williams will recap his recent eight-month mission aboard the International Space Station during a news conference at 2:45 p.m. EDT Tuesday, Aug. 4, from the agency’s Johnson Space Center in Houston.
